method: Real audio module with a simulated Web Audio graph; real app with engine fixtures and virtual time. Browser/subjective listening recorded separately.

checks.name: No audio before a user gesture; all six local buffers decode once
Only positive net wins use fanfares; partial/break-even returns remain quiet
Crossfade bonus loop; immediate master mute cuts a fanfare and persists
Hidden tabs are silent; returning never replays an old cue
Saved mute, missing files, unavailable storage and blocked audio are nonfatal
Late buffers never play a stale win; closing page releases audio
